errors.what: A spread that a price list limits is never priced. In the fx block, buildTariff reads only r.rate and never reads the line's `spread` field. Altshuler Trade's record has a conversion fee of 0 and a spread of 'עד 0.7% משער המרה', and Meitav Trade's has a fee of 0.13% and a spread of 'עד 0.8%'. Both records' notes say the spread is 'priced at 0.7% / 0.8% (D56)', but the engine prices Altshuler's conversion at 0 and Meitav's at 0.13%. IBI's 0.7% is priced only because its record puts it in `rate`. This breaks D56 ('An "up to" fee is priced at its ceiling', docs/product.md:76) and D65's reading that only an unlimited spread goes unpriced (docs/product.md:85). The D65 note on the account card names Altshuler and Meitav as houses that limit the spread, yet their figures leave that limit out. Fixing it is a ranking change and needs its own evidence.

F-102 keeps each bank's nominal 2026 minimum for the whole plan ('The nominal minimum is kept for the whole plan'). The rule base has a primary-source rule that changes this fee in 8 months. BANK-35 (Governor's order, Kovetz Hatakanot 12431, 17.6.2026, s.3(1), https://olaw.org.il/takanot/takanot-12431.pdf, checked 2026-10-26) caps managing a payment account, a current account included, at NIS 5 a month for 0 to 2 actions from 1.7.2027, and repeals the basic-track order (BANK-17). Seven of the ten recorded minimums are above NIS 5: Hapoalim 5.30, Leumi 5.50, Discount 5.90, First International and Massad 6.30, Mercantile 6.40, Mizrahi-Tefahot 6.80 and Jerusalem 9.50. So F-102 probably overstates the cost from month 9 on, over 20 years. The rule base leaves open how the amended rules count an action for the cap. F-102 cites neither BANK-17 nor BANK-35, and the engine shows no flag. By the rule-base procedure, this should be named as a missing or open rule rather than replaced by a flat assumption.

After D64 is built, every bank record still lists the current account in `left_out` as not priced. For example, Leumi's entry says 'No other bank's record prices its current account, so not priced here (fair comparison)' and Hapoalim's says 'No bank's record prices the current account yet'. Each record now also carries `current_account`, and F-102 prices it. The two parts of each record contradict each other, and CLAUDE.md ground rule 10 requires the leftovers to be cleaned up.

The notes on One Zero's foreign custody line are stale. They still say 'No engine field holds a per-event cost, so this is not priced; the value stays the bank's printed 0', while the same record now prices the 50 USD per event in one-zero-custodian-corporate-event (D67).

F-102 treats a general premise as a rule: 'A bank's securities account rests on a current account at the same bank'. The il-finance rule base has no general rule saying so. The only text is BRK-28, scoped to one institution (Bank Leumi's general terms: the securities deposit is debited and credited through the client's account). Each bank's `left_out` restates the premise without a quote from that bank's documents. CLAUDE.md says a statement about the whole market comes from law or from a count over every collected institution. This rule is missing from the base.

An account built on a bank (F-101 group radio: students at Discount, students and released soldiers at Mercantile) is charged the ordinary customer's current-account minimum. F-102 defines a_p as 'the price list's minimum for an ordinary customer' and does not cover group accounts. The group annexes (for example Mercantile Annex A pp.31-33) were not read for current-account terms, and Yahav's record shows such groups can be exempt ('Young customers, soldiers and students are exempt'). Giving a group the ordinary price for a line its own annex was not read for is an inference, not a reading.

D65 and D66 are not applied as written. D65 puts the spread sentence 'in its block on what the houses advertise against their price lists', a block D57 removed on 2026-11-05. The build puts both notes in a fold on the account card instead, and docs/product.md was not updated. The decision text and the build disagree until the founder records where the notes stand.
errors.where: docs/product.md:85-86 (D65, D66) vs docs/product.md:77 (D57 change of 2026-11-05)

errors.what: Several current_account sources do not show the figure recorded as a monthly minimum. The quotes for Leumi ('5.50 ש"ח לפעולה (בפיקוח)'), Discount, Yahav, Hapoalim and Mercantile give the price per teller action. The minimum clause (note 3, (*), (02)/(07), (03)) is only in `notes`. The figure is right once the note is read, since the minimum is at most one teller action and the ceiling is counted under D56. In the other direction, the Mizrahi-Tefahot, First International and Massad quotes give the minimum clause without the number. One Zero's current_account has no quote and no page. docs/data-schema.md:386 requires 'its page and quote', and the validator does not check it.

errors.what: The source of One Zero's corporate-event line has no `page` field and no `quote`. The page is only in the title ('עמ' 17') and the quoted words are only in notes. Its rule_ids lists BRK-16 only and not BRK-38, which is One Zero's tariff record.
D64 gives the cost as '4 to 9.50 ₪ a month', but One Zero, which the validator also requires to carry a current account, is recorded at 0. The decision's range and the data disagree.

F-63 still says the cumulative-cost chart draws 'the provider's own four lines (trade, custody, FX, fixed fee)' and that 'the series ends at the run's four fee totals'. The engine's providerFees now adds a fifth line, account (F-102). The method text does not match the code.

Discount's record treats the Digital Classic exemption from the current-account minimum as an offer under D56 ('joining it is a choice of service'). The research file it cites classifies the same exemption as 'Guaranteed for the current account (joining the digital branch is the only condition)'. The two readings disagree. Whether Discount's row is 5.90 or 0 needs the finance reviewer's or the founder's ruling.

F-103 leaves the charge per event out of the sale gain because whether it counts under TXS-06 'is not settled by the rule base'. That gap was not added as an open question to the tax file or to coverage.md. TXS-06 counts management and custody fees for securities transactions, and the line is a custodian's charge. The engine silently takes the reading that gives the higher tax.

The test meant to show that 'a fund in Tel Aviv' keeps its price uses an Israeli `mutual_fund_units` fund. It does not test a foreign fund listed on Tel Aviv (`etf_units`) quoted in USD, the one case where `input.currency` is set and only the line's `applies_to` keeps F-103 off. D67 requires that case to stay unchanged.
